name: Grand Street Bridge
facts: Grand Street Bridge, completed in 1902, is a steel through‑truss swing bridge that opened its 230‑foot span on April 21, 1902, after a $200,000 bond issue authorized by Mayor Van Wyck.
The bridge’s original 1875 wooden deck, a single‑track railroad, collapsed in 1889, prompting a costly 1890 replacement that cost $70,000 and included a $850 shelter for the bridge keeper.
Grand Street Bridge’s 1903 swing span was engineered to provide a 91‑foot clearance on both sides of Newtown Creek, a design change that doubled the eastern opening to match the western side.
